quick_brief: Week 1 Web Challenge: Test your knowledge of configuring your on-premises environment, installing Laravel, basic navigation, and implementing MVC!

questions.text: Which local development server is best for running databases and MySQL locally?
What is the main PHP package manager used to download the Laravel framework and libraries?
What is the correct command line command to run a virtual local development server for Laravel?
Under which folder do we find the main web routes file (routes/web.php) to direct website visitors?
In the MVC website architecture, which part represents user interface screens written in HTML and formatting codes?
What is the main benefit of using MVC architecture paths in designing large websites?
options: Separating the data modification logic (Model) from the display interfaces (View) to facilitate programming and updating
Prevent the user from clicking with the right mouse button
questions.correct: Separating the data modification logic (Model) from the display interfaces (View) to facilitate programming and updating

questions.text: Which script function do we use inside a route to instruct the browser to display a web interface named 'welcome'?
When using the route code: Route::get('/hello', function() { return 'Hello'; }), what is shown to the user when typing the link?
What is the default link and port that exposes the Laravel website interface when running artisan server?
In the MVC architecture, who is responsible for coordinating requests, receiving inputs, and processing them before they are routed to the interface?
Write a route code to link the '/contact' sublink so that it displays an interface file named 'contact_us'.
Write a Permian path that receives a variable with the cake name '{cakeName}' via the link and returns the greeting phrase 'Welcome to store:' followed by the cake name.
